title: Mint body
description: The creation of credits, signed by the operator (credits.md 5.1, CR-2, register row DK67). Every credit that enters the ledger without a debit elsewhere is one of these records, so a replica replaying the log reproduces the minted total. Credits are accounting entries, not money. Chain: none (prev is null).

amount.description: At least 1 credit. The log refuses 0 with amount_not_positive.

authority.description: Who or what authorised it, in words (for example "operator", or the name of the starter claim).
